test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is NOT a function of Gram Panchayats?

options.text: Scrutinises and approves budgets of the Block Samities

solution:
The correct answer is __**Scrutinises and approves budgets of the Block Samities.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The administrative** functions** of Gram Panchayats are:

 
 
• Maintenance, repair, and building of wells drains, bridges, and other **public works and welfare projects**.
 
• Install and maintain good street lamps.
